observations.review: The corrosion finding is semantically contradictory: code corrosion/type oil_sight_glass but description says no visible oil sight glass. Finding boxes repeat motor box. No healthy/unsafe status can be inferred.

Intended exposed coupling observation missed. Reported grease drip and slightly loose bolt lack clear supporting visual evidence in this generated development example. Torque/looseness cannot be confirmed from RGB.

Text identifies oil below visible MIN and localizes sight glass reasonably on visual inspection, but also emits unsupported whole-image corrosion with component_type oil_sight_glass. Partial useful observation is not a reliable overall diagnosis.

conclusion: Prompt constraints did not reliably prevent unsupported findings or ensure desired guard/oil behavior. Valid JSON/schema does not establish semantic correctness. Do not replace the production prompt on this evidence. Prefer reviewed region-level data and specialist detection models; keep manual confirmation and unknown outcomes.
experiment_limitations: Three familiar development examples, two synthetic; no human-approved ground truth and no statistical accuracy claim.
No paired baseline run within this experiment. Prior errors are context, not a measured comparison.

Source PNG files for cases2/3 were replaced by parent with WEBP during first inference. Cases2/3 use pinned deployed WEBP; old PNG hashes recorded in cases.json. Interrupted file lookup made no extra inference call.
Components empty, so component-ID association not evaluated. CPU timings are observations in this running environment, not phone latency estimates.
